item.title: Letter to the Editor: Proceed With Caution Before Welcoming a Data Center
item.description: Explore reader Kali McLaughlin says, "Questions about noise, water use, electric grid strain, and public health must be answered before any data center proposal advances." The post Letter to the Editor: Proceed With Caution Before Welcoming a Data Center appeared first on exploreVenango.

item.title: ‘Living The Issues’: Area Farmers And Officials Connect Face-To-Face On Rural Policy Challenges
item.description: “You hear the issues from the people that are living the issues,” Venango County Commissioner Sam Breene said. “Just knowing what problems they’re facing and what things are going well for them. It’s valuable for us so we can advocate for them and try to make sure our policies don’t hurt them.” The post ‘Living The Issues’: Area Farmers And Officials Connect Face-To-Face On Rural Policy Challenges appeared first on exploreVenango.
